description: Erection of single storey side and rear 'wrap around' extension including conversion of the existing garage into a habitable space
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 20SI2318130RR02, 20SI2318130RR03, 20SI2318130RR04, fire safety statement. Received: 18/04/2024
20SI2318130RR01 (rev.A), 20SI2318130RR05 (rev.A). Received: 11/06/2024
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy
Condition : 5 - Prior to commencement of any above ground works pursuant to the implementation of the rear and side extensions hereby approved, proof of demolition of the existing outbuilding shall have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing.
Reason: In order to safeguard the living conditions of the current and future occupiers of the site and that of the neighbours, and protect the character of the area.
